# clinvar-gkm/1.2.0 (ClinVar-GKM's published 1.2.0 schema set)

The bundle schema set for ClinVar-GKM bundle `schema_version` 1.2.0, as w3id serves it from ClinVar-GKM's 1.2.0 tag:
`schema-set/` was written on 2026-11-23 by `scripts/vendor-schemas.py
https://w3id.org/clingen/schema/clinvar-gkm/1.2.0/clinvar-gkm-bundle.schema.json` (`MANIFEST.json` lists every file, its
`$id`, where it was read from and its sha256). 143 files, schema set sha256
`3b3920180d08f3343d7466ce55bbcb95f5cbc467c505a4e03797b8f3c48d6798`. Its root `$id` is the URL it is served at.

No column set: the suite builds 1.2.0 bundles with the generated default (`--version-property schema_version`). Read by
`tests/test_apply.py` with `real-1.2.0-apply/`.
